title: Ezberdeki tarih

characters.MAN: a young man of about thirty with short brown hair and a short beard, wearing a mustard yellow sweater
characters.FRIEND: a young man of about thirty with curly black hair and round glasses, wearing a navy blue coat
characters.KID1: a boy of about twelve with short brown hair, wearing a mustard yellow sweater
characters.KID2: a boy of about twelve with curly black hair and round glasses, wearing a navy blue jacket

scenes.text:
Konuşmayı bıraktığın birinin doğum gününü
neden hâlâ ezbere biliyorsun?
scenes.prompt: On an autumn evening, {MAN} sits alone by a rainy window in a cozy room, looking outside thoughtfully, warm lamp light, golden leaves blowing past the glass.

scenes.text:
Çünkü yıllarca o gün
yan yana mum üflediniz.
scenes.prompt: At a birthday party in a warm living room, {KID1} on the left and {KID2} on the right lean over a cake with glowing candles on the table, both laughing, soft candle light.

scenes.text:
Sonra şehirler değişti, telefonlar sustu;
kimse kızmadı bile.
scenes.prompt: At an old train station in autumn, {MAN} stands alone on the platform seen from behind, watching a train leave into the distance, golden leaves falling.

scenes.text:
Ama her yıl o sabah
aklına ilk o geliyor, değil mi?
scenes.prompt: At sunrise, {MAN} sits on the edge of his bed next to a window, a soft smile on his face as if remembering something, golden morning light, autumn tree outside.

scenes.text:
Belki o da seninkini hatırlıyor.
Bunu ona gönder.
scenes.prompt: At sunset, {FRIEND} sits alone on a wooden bench in an autumn park, smiling softly as if remembering an old friend, golden leaves falling around him.

caption:
Onu hatırlıyorsun, değil mi?

Bazı tarihler takvimden silinir, kalpten silinmez. 🤍

Bunu doğum gününü unutmadığın o dosta gönder.
